$comment: Koi no Yokan shop catalog. Registered with RUN at deploy; the ids here
are the ones src/config/platform.ts must reference. Until this is
deployed and those PLATFORM_IDS placeholders are replaced with the real
ids, every purchase surface in the game hides itself rather than
offering a button that cannot complete.
Prices are in RB (RUN Bits, the platform hard currency, ~100 RB = $1).
The six heart tiers follow RUN's pricing template: a flat base rate with
a growing bonus that pushes toward the larger packs.
